# Packages under internal/ with no importer (rule D9; TestOrphans).
# One import path per line, optionally followed by " pending:<ticket-id>".
# Sorted bytewise: LC_ALL=C sort. Comments and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Plain lines are the frozen orphans: they must equal orphanBasis in
# orphans_test.go, the list may only shrink, and a line whose package gains an
# importer (or is deleted) fails as stale. `go test ./internal/repoqa/ -run
# Orphan -update` drops stale plain lines and prints the basis to paste.
#
# No pending exceptions are approved. Every "pending:" marker fails, including
# missing packages and closed Tickets. Wire a consumer or delete the package.
# See ../Architecture-Guardrails.md before changing this policy.

internal/controlplane/sim
internal/cost
internal/domain
internal/installmeta
internal/model
internal/plugin/lifecycle
internal/runbook
internal/runtime
internal/webhook
